COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.

2. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

6. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

7. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.

8. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

10. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.

14. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.

15. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.

16. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

----
